calculation_policy.covariance_rule: 20 non-statistical rows fully correlated by same component; statistical_angular_acceleration independent across runs; no cross-item terms
calculation_policy.enclosure: positive rational interval arithmetic; q_i bounds l_i/(l_i+sum_others u_j), u_i/(u_i+sum_others l_j); one whole-domain box; dependency overestimation allowed
calculation_policy.q: a_i = 1/(g_i*sum_k x_ik^2); q_i = a_i/sum_j a_j = p_i*g_i/sum_j(p_j*g_j)
calculation_policy.scalar_encoding: exact fractions from finite decimal strings; no binary floats
calculation_policy.square_root_display: integer square root with exact outward rounding; presentation only

candidate_schedule.completeness: finite witness schedule, not exhaustive; no probability meaning
candidate_schedule.formula: x_ik = midpoint_ik + t*half_width_ik; same t for all cells; evaluate all candidates before comparison

claim_limits: Conditional component-rounding consistency only; not the actual cause of the discrepancy.
No new measurement, empirical model, raw-data replication, source-authorization upgrade, physical prediction or Lean proof.
Bounds are conservative enclosures, not certified extrema or an attainable range.
Witness scenarios do not replace frozen measurement inputs or outputs.
No p-value, sample probability, significance level or joint consistency of the entire publication is asserted.

source_reference.locator: Supplement Section 6, AAF paragraph, printed p. 13; previously reviewed in PR #38

decision.scope: Conditional on the declared component bins, fixed G inputs and correlation model.

external_anchor.scope: Implementation-rule freeze; HUST result and exploratory rounding scenarios already known.

interpretation: A concrete admissible component scenario reaches the comparison bin; actual cause and probability are not established.

rounding_policy.admissible_domain: Cartesian product of 63 component bins; no probability distribution, latent equalities or independence claim
rounding_policy.assumption: nearest rounding; actual publisher rounding and tie convention not established
rounding_policy.excluded: rounding of central values, apparatus primitives, displayed individual totals and other publication outputs
rounding_policy.fixed: three reconstructed individual G central values and correlation classes
rounding_policy.witness_endpoints: strict interior for positive-width intervals; equality for exact intervals
